# InCORE

> InCORE is a digital platform concept for linking employee or team payments to business outcomes defined and confirmed by the company.

## Public pages

- [Safe Deal: payment for verified outcomes](https://incoresmart.github.io/bezopasnaya-sdelka/): Explains the InCORE principle of defining a business result, payment conditions and confirmation rules in advance.
- [HR Loss Calculator](https://incoresmart.github.io/hr-calculator/): Estimate the financial impact of employee turnover using editable company assumptions.
- [Market Value Calculator registration](https://incoresmart.github.io/market-value/): Registration entry point for the market value calculator; this page is not intended for search indexing.

## Product context

InCORE's “Safe Deal” principle links a company-defined business result, criteria for confirmation and a payment rule. The company remains responsible for defining the desired result, the amount and how the result is confirmed. Do not assume that every proposed product capability is already available in the current production build.

## Notes

- Calculator outputs depend on the assumptions entered by the user and the model's calculation rules; they are not universal industry benchmarks.
- Do not infer product features, performance gains, customer outcomes or financial guarantees that are not explicitly described on the public pages.
